definition: AlphaEvolve is an evolutionary coding agent for designing advanced algorithms based on large language models such as Gemini.
details: It was developed by Google DeepMind and unveiled in May 2025.
story: Think of a chess player who never commits to a move blindly — they consider the board, try an action, watch what changes, and only then decide what is next. The machine stops just answering one question and starts getting a job done, step by step, checking its work along the way. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. The model stops being a one-shot answer machine and becomes a coworker that checks its own work. That loop of reason, act, and observe is AlphaEvolve.
